name: RELATIVE_MOMENTUM_7D_DAILY_V1
universe: Fixed 26 currently listed/liquid symbols from previous audit; survival and current-universe selection bias explicitly retained, no whole-market claim
data: Hourly OHLCV, current contract rules, historical funding settlements; only complete histories used
eligibility: At decision: seven complete prior UTC days, 14-day ATR, prior24h notional proxy >=5000000USDT (vol * current contractSize * H1 close)
ranking: Prior7day close-to-close return; choose top floor(N*0.20) positive-return names for LONG and bottom floor(N*0.20) negative-return names for SHORT, min1; ties symbol
entry: 01:00 UTC after 00:00 UTC decision; weights and side fixed from information available at 00:00
sizing: Half nominal budget per tail, equal slots; absent-sign slots stay cash; no redistribution; per-name cap20%; scale down to gross<=1x equity and expected aggregate stop risk including modeled trading costs<=2%equity
leverage: No leverage amplification in primary replay; not a validation of bot floor10x or a1USDT account
rounding: Current contract min/step/max rules; floor quantity, skip below minimum; no post-skip redistribution
stop: 2*ATR14 simple mean of daily true ranges known at decision, fixed from entry mid; close at stop with adverse gap; skip nonpositive LONG stop
exit: Stop or next daily01:00UTC exit, whichever first; flatten and reopen each day even if rank persists; no fixed TP and no prospective TP-based RR gate

costs.funding: Observed signed funding settlements during holding using H1 marks; conservative intrahour stop/funding ordering; separately report costs

intrabar: H1 stop timing coarse; stop at open for adverse gap, otherwise assume hour-end for timestamp; ignore funding credits if intrahour ordering with stop unknown; do not charge settlements at hour-end after an intrahour stop
funding_coverage: Require history before entry start and after end and no unexplained gap above8h across test; report coverage exclusions; do not fill missing funding with zero
validation: Rules frozen before fetching results; last30days untouched by this model's rule selection; dates precede Oct/Nov intraday samples; no reoptimization after split
metrics: trade win rate after trading costs and funding
comparison: BTC buy-and-hold1x contextual benchmark with same execution costs/funding, different risk exposure explicitly noted
